_readme: BeamRunner balance (combat, progression, adaptive difficulty). Every field of Scripts/Core/Balance/BalanceConfig.cs can be set here; fields left out keep their code defaults, and broken values are repaired at load (BalanceConfig.Sanitized). Formulas: BlockHP(L) = BlockHpBase x BlockHpGrowth^(L-1); UpgradeCost(n) = CostBase[stat] x CostGrowth^n. Arrays indexed by upgrade: Damage, FireRate, Crit, Spread, Pierce. Rating tables: index 0..4 = rating -2 (Relaxed) .. +2 (Expert), interpolated in between. See docs/ARCHITECTURE.md (Balance). Keys starting with _ are ignored.
